events.title: Football Federation Australia launches Australia's new national competition, the A-League , replacing the former National Soccer League .
자크 상티니 resigns as manager of 토트넘 홋스퍼 , citing personal reasons. 마르틴 욜 is named caretaker manager .
아스널 draw 1–1 at 크리스털 팰리스, allowing 첼시 to bypass them into first place for the first time in the season, going two points clear; the latter winning 1–0 at home to 에버턴.
The "caretaker" is removed from 마르틴 욜 's title, as he signs a contract to manage Spurs through the 2006–07 season .
브라이언 롭슨 is named as the new manager of 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 .
AFC 윔블던 sets a United Kingdom record for consecutive unbeaten league games in senior football, at 76, with a 1–1 draw at Bromley in Ryman Division One .

The England national team loses to Spain 1–0 at the Santiago Bernabéu Stadium in Madrid . However, the match is marred by racist chants from the crowd aimed at black England players. 애슐리 콜 and 숀 라이트필립스 were particular targets of abuse; every time either touched the ball, monkey noises came from the crowd.

해리 레드냅 quits as manager of 포츠머스 following a row with chairman AC 밀란 Mandarić over the appointment of new Director of Football Velimir Zajec at the club. Zajec then replaces Redknapp as manager with immediate effect.
Sir 알렉스 퍼거슨 takes charge of his 1,000th match at 맨체스터 유나이티드 .

As November draws to a close, 첼시 have leapfrogged 아스널 at the top of the Premier League and are now five points ahead. 에버턴, 맨체스터 유나이티드 and 미들즈브러 complete the top five, though they are now some way behind the top two in terms of points. 웨스트브로미치 앨비언, 노리치 시티 and 사우샘프턴 occupy the bottom three places, while 토트넘 홋스퍼's promising start to the season has tailed off and they now stand just three places and one point above the drop zone. 입스위치 타운 are now top of the Championship, with 위건 애슬레틱 second. 선덜랜드's good form has lifted them to third place, while the playoff zone is completed by Reading, 웨스트햄 유나이티드 and Queen's Park 레인저스.
